notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only, own tab, direct to https://www.target.com.au. No block of any kind was hit (the prior Home-Decor pass's Akamai 'Access Denied' was an HTTP-layer artefact; a real Chrome session sees none of it). robots.txt read in-tab: User-agent:* disallows only /checkout/, /my-account/, /search/*, sort/view query variants - no Claude/ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai rule, so extraction is permitted. TREE: three independent sources unioned per the sitemap cross-check rule - (a) the Home mega-menu on /c/home/W99700, (b) medias/feeds/sitemap/category-sitemap.xml (1551 category URLs, keyword-scanned locally for table|chair|stool|bench|sofa|bed|desk|cabinet|wardrobe|dresser|shelf|bookcase|seat|ottoman|drawer|furnitur|cot|nursery|rack|stand|trolley|unit|lounge|recliner|daybed|sideboard|vanity), and (c) the Furniture PLP's own sub-category chip strip. All three agree the Furniture department (/c/home/furniture/W134351) has exactly five children: Bean Bags, Bedroom Furniture (one child, Bedside Tables), Drawers, Ottomans, Shelving. The sitemap surfaced no furniture node the nav had hidden. QTY: every leaf's rendered listing header 'N products found' was read from the page HTML and independently corroborated against the same page's data-cnstrc-num-results attribute AND against Constructor.io browse total_num_results (ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<ID>, key_kWcXakjuyHSxpu75) fetched same-origin from the loaded page via javascript_tool. All three agreed exactly on all 11 leaves, so the rendered header is used and is trustworthy here. Constructor is the same layer that drives the site's own PLP, and the prior pass exhaustion-verified it on two nodes of different size. BAD-SLUG TRAP: an invented node /c/home/furniture/sofas/W99999999 returns HTTP 500 with an error page and no count - this platform does NOT silently serve a parent listing for a bogus slug. Every leaf below was additionally confirmed HTTP 200 with a matching rel=canonical and an h1 naming the node asked for. PARENT-AS-LEAF: per the deepest-node rule, Furniture (100) is represented by the Category column and Bedroom Furniture (46) is emitted as a grouping row because it has an extractable child (Bedside Tables, 28). Recording this honestly: 17 products sit directly on the Furniture node with no sub-category at all (coffee tables, entertainment unit, upholstered dining chair, bar stools, lounge chair) and 18 sit directly on Bedroom Furniture (side tables, wardrobes, garment racks, shoe cabinet, 8 duplicate 'Laynie Linen/Cotton Cushion' listings that are miscategorised textiles). Those 35 are not reachable through any deeper listing URL and so are not represented by any leaf row. OUTSIDE THE FURNITURE DEPARTMENT: five further furniture-typed leaves live under other departments and were pulled in after title inspection - Kids Bedroom Furniture (Bedroom > Kids Bedroom), Clothing Racks and Shoe Racks (Storage), Cots & Bassinets (Baby > Sleep) and High Chairs (Baby > Feeding). EXCLUDED AFTER TITLE SCAN (extracted the product names once via Constructor, filtered locally, never enumerated by hand): Bedroom Storage W134658 (49 - storage boxes/organisers/bags, standalone storage goods), Bathroom Storage W276140 (58 - shower caddies, cosmetic organisers, drawer inserts), Outdoor Dining W348332 (36 - placemats, serving boards, drink dispensers, tablecloths; no outdoor furniture), Outdoor Camping W582518 (33 - wipes, torches, backpacks), Wall & Floating Shelves W822029 (wall shelves belong to Wall Decor per the shelving line), Plant Stands W1863761 (decor), Cot Sets W904743 (cot bedding), Nursery Decor W717000, Desk Lamps/Table Lamps (lighting), all bedding/napery/mattress nodes. ABSENCE FINDINGS worth recording: Target Australia sells NO sofas, NO dining tables or dining sets, NO beds or bed frames, NO desks, NO office chairs and NO outdoor/garden furniture at all - Home Office (W1209706) holds a single product (kids stationery) and Outdoor Living (92) is camping, BBQ and picnicware. The whole furniture assortment is Anko-branded small furniture: bedside/side tables, drawer units, bookshelves, ottomans and a handful of chairs. IDENTITY: verified independent of Target US (SR 22) - different corporate owner (Wesfarmers/Kmart Group), different platform, different search key, different catalogue.
